item.name: Rooftop Map
item.layout: Elevated rooftop arena with stairs, ramps, and open sightlines
item.updateContext: Replaced the launch Square Arena during the April 2026 map and zombie movement update
item.holdStyle: Hold stair and ramp chokepoints instead of spreading across open ground
item.laneNotes: Watch the entry ramps and stairwell approaches so zombie packs funnel into predictable fire lanes.
item.bestFor: Barricade and turret holds, piercing shots, area damage, and controlled retreats
item.performanceNote: Rooftop Map launched with public reports of lower FPS; lowering Roblox graphics is the practical workaround until optimization changes.
item.caveat: Exact in-game display name should be rechecked after the next map update; public sources use Rooftop Map or new map wording.

item.name: Square Arena
item.updateContext: Launch-era arena replaced by Rooftop Map during the April 2026 map update
item.holdStyle: Open-field positioning with fewer natural chokepoints
item.laneNotes: Use it mainly to understand older guides that discuss flat placement, open movement, or pre-rooftop zombie pathing.
item.bestFor: Stale-guide context and comparing old open-field advice against the current Rooftop layout
item.performanceNote: No current performance note because Square Arena is not the active public layout.
item.caveat: Do not treat Square Arena as the current public map unless future in-game verification shows it returned in a selectable mode.
